name: Argentiferous-Hoodoo
description: The sea here is thick with dissolved metals, so sunsets burn green and gold above the waves. Beneath them wait a tidally locked hemisphere, and everything the light never reaches.
Breathable air makes every breath a small transaction. Locals, when there are locals, move slowly and speak quietly, conserving everything.
Approach protocols for the automated beacon of unknown purpose are simple: announce once, dock slowly, compliment the cooking.
The charts mark this world in cautious amber. Those who ignore the marking tend to come back rich, changed, or not at all.
